title: HomeBase
tagline: Discover and interact with your favorite onchain apps all in one place.
description:
HomeBase is a dashboard that aggregates various Base projects, streamlining the experience for those entering the onchain world. Individuals can create a Coinbase smart wallet and seamlessly interact with different onchain applications. 

This project serves as a cultural hub, making it easier for users to explore new projects and interact with onchain apps, all within one interface.
how_its_made:
HomeBase was built by integrating various crypto APIs and smart contract reads to create a seamless user experience. These APIs were integrated into a unified backend that feeds data into a responsive frontend.

- OnchainKit was used for creating the Farcaster Frame and Coinbase smart wallet interactions.

- Wagmi/viem were used for building transactions to write to the chain.

- APIs Used:
Blockscout for Base stats and transactions.
L2 Beat for real-time TVL data.
CoinGecko for accurate Memecoin pricing.
Reservoir for NFT pricing.
BasePaint.
Moshicam.
Yellow Collective.
Bountycaster.
